# Welcome {.unnumbered}

![](images/welcome-hero.png){fig-alt="The Mini-Me Desktop window"}

## What is Mini-Me?

**Mini-Me** is a research assistant that runs on your Windows computer. You talk to it the
same way you would write a message to a colleague, and it does the research work for you:

- **Finds scientific papers** on a topic and summarises what they say, with references.
- **Finds datasets** in the CIP Dataverse.
- **Reads your own PDFs** and lets you search them by meaning, not just by words.
- **Checks and cleans your data files** (for example, an Excel or CSV file).
- **Analyses your data** — patterns, charts, statistics and predictions.
- **Suggests and tests ideas** (hypotheses) based on the literature.
- **Writes a report** with references, which you can save as a PDF.

Behind the scenes, Mini-Me has a team of **specialists** — each one good at a single job. You
don't need to know which one to ask: a **coordinator** reads your question and passes it to the
right specialist for you.

## Who is this manual for?

For everyone. You do **not** need to know how to program, use a terminal or install software
by hand. If you can use email and a web browser, you can use Mini-Me.

## How to read this manual

Mini-Me should already be installed and set up on your computer. If this is your first time,
read these chapters in order:

1. [A tour of the window](the-window.qmd) — what each part of the screen is for.
2. [Asking questions](asking-questions.qmd) — how to get your first answer.

After that, use the other chapters when you need them.

::: {.callout-tip title="Opening this manual from Mini-Me"}
You can open this manual at any time from inside the app: go to **Settings → Help → Open user
manual**, or press `Ctrl+P` and choose **User manual**.
:::

::: {.callout-important title="Please keep in mind"}
Mini-Me uses **generative AI**. It is a helpful assistant, but it can make mistakes.

- **Check the results** with a subject-matter expert before you rely on them.
- **Check every reference** before you cite it in your own work.
- **Do not enter confidential or personal data**, unpublished research or third-party
  intellectual property.
- **Say that you used AI** when you share or publish work made with Mini-Me.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="About this manual"}
This manual was drafted with the help of generative AI.
:::
